thread:
jordan: deploy-bot flagged canary latency spike in canary-east-1, kv_cache miss rate jumped. deploy-bot suggests rollback 2.5.1 -> 2.5.0. anyone object to a manual rollback?

deploy-bot: ALERT: Canary slice=canary-east-1 p95=1200ms (+60%), error_rate=1.8% (+6x), kv_cache_miss=42% (baseline 5%). Recommendation: pin version 2.5.0 and shift traffic. Link: https://go/deploy/alerts/1711119999

maria: seeing the same traces in prod sampling, correlation with v2.5.1 KV hash change looks likely. I don't see a quick config toggle to revert without deploy.
sam: is there a KV-warmup flag we can flip? last time a cache warming toggle saved us for a similar regression.
rachel: need to know customer risk and whether there are any dedicated customers on the canary slice. if we rollback, I'll draft a short release note and a customer blurb.
ops-bot: ROLLBACK RUNBOOK (condensed):
```
1) pin-service --service inference --version 2.5.0 --scope canary-east-1
2) shift-traffic --from 2.5.1 --to 2.5.0 --percent 100 --grace 30s
3) monitor p95, errors, kv_miss for 15m
4) if stable, unpin and bump release-notes
```
Link to full runbook: https://go/runbooks/rollback-basic
oncall: I'm ready to run the manual rollback. Will need infra eng to approve exec and someone to own customer comms.
maria: +1 infra. I'll execute step 1-2 and monitor logs. Posting timeline here before action.
sam: I'll prepare release notes snippet and a short canned email to affected customers. draft: "We rolled back 2.5.1 to 2.5.0 due to a latency regression linked to KV cache changes. No data loss. We're investigating root cause."
jordan: plan: rollback start @1711121200 UTC (in ~10min), monitor 30m, then update release notes and notify. I've opened PM-4589 for postmortem.
deploy-bot: ACTION: rollback job queued by @maria. rolling back service=inference canary-east-1 from 2.5.1 -> 2.5.0. job id=rb-1711120200.
maria: exec started. running pin-service now. will post progress.
ops-bot: tip: keep canary traffic at 20% for first 2m while monitoring KV miss heatmap.
maria: pin done, traffic shifted to 2.5.0, warming period. initial metrics: p95 down to 420ms, error_rate 0.3%, kv_cache_miss 6%. :thumbsup:
oncall: nice. hold the rollback for 30m and if stable, mark rollback complete and notify customers.
rachel: drafting the comms and release note update now. will post before we mark complete.
sam: comms ready, will send on approval. short subject: "Service update: rolling back inference 2.5.1 — latency regression"
jordan: marking as rollback-in-progress. thanks all. postmortem ticket and next steps in PM-4589.
deploy-bot: JOB COMPLETE: rb-1711120200 status=success. final metrics attached.
maria: rollback done and verified. switching monitoring to post-rollback workspace.
rachel: sending customer blurb now. pinging legal for FYI.
 jordon: (typo) — thanks everyone, closing thread and will link postmortem here when ready.
